title: SWEET PEA & THE OPEN STRINGS
style: Style: Acoustic indie-pop, ukulele, guitar, strings, Spanish phrases, emotional build
lyrics:
[Intro — ukulele harmonics, vinyl crackle, soft strings]

Dulce niña… sweet pea…
Open strings… open heart…

[Verse 1]

Three years old, suitcase small
New skies, new streets, new walls
A friend says, “Here, try this tune”
Tiny hands, a yellow moon

Open strings and nursery rhymes
Cow jumps high, right on time
Mama whispers, “Listen close”
Hay magia en cada voz

[Pre-Chorus]

Sweet pea, sing it slow
Let your little heartbeat show
Chickadee, don’t be afraid
You were born for every stage

[Chorus]

She feels the music in her bones
Every place becomes her home
Chickadee, don’t ever hide
That light you carry deep inside

Dulce amor, play it true
El mundo espera por you
Sing it loud, sing it free
This is who you’re meant to be

[Verse 2]

Living rooms and afternoon
Songs before she learned the rules
Darwin dust and ocean air
Every dream is waiting there

[Bridge]

Mi niña, mira aquí
Your voice is history

[Final Chorus]

(repeat chorus)

[Outro]

Open strings… open heart…
That’s where legends start…
